interpretation: The new owner fault is not a timeout. The test checked expected DOM text before the failed liveness assertion.
A failure after rendering, including selection restoration or cleanup, is a hypothesis, not an established root cause.
No projection rejection was recorded. Do not classify this as the earlier impact-metadata or required-property failure without more evidence.
Passing exception-capture runs do not prove a fix or that changing capture mode is neutral. The original fault remains open.
Focused repetitions exclude seven clipboard-boundary cases which preceded the failure in the mixed run. They do not rule out an effect of that preceding workload.
The ordered-prefix follow-up restores that test order but still changes exception capture and adds afterEach evidence calls. Its passing result does not isolate either observer effect.
